sn22.30:1.2: “Bhikkhus, the arising, continuation, production, and manifestation of form is the arising of suffering, the continuation of disease, the manifestation of aging-and-death.
sn22.30:1.6: of consciousness is the arising of suffering, the continuation of disease, the manifestation of aging-and-death.
sn22.30:1.7: “The cessation, subsiding, and passing away of form …
sn22.30:1.11: of consciousness is the cessation of suffering, the subsiding of disease, the passing away of aging-and-death.”
